<?php
require '/wordpress/wp-load.php';

if (!defined('WC_VERSION') || WC_VERSION !== '11.3.1') {
    throw new RuntimeException('WooCommerce 11.3.1 is required');
}

update_option('woocommerce_feature_ucp_enabled', 'yes');
update_option('woocommerce_currency', 'USD');
update_option('blog_public', 1);
update_option('permalink_structure', '/%postname%/');
global $wp_rewrite;
$wp_rewrite->init();
$discovery = new Automattic\WooCommerce\Internal\Ucp\UcpDiscovery();
$discovery->register_feature_hooks();

$finish = new WC_Product_Attribute();
$finish->set_name('Finish');
$finish->set_options(['Blue', 'Green']);
$finish->set_visible(true);
$finish->set_variation(true);

$product = new WC_Product_Variable();
$product->set_name('UCP Catalog Fixture Mug');
$product->set_status('publish');
$product->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
$product->set_attributes([$finish]);
$product->save();

$ids = [];
foreach (['Blue' => '12.34', 'Green' => '56.78'] as $color => $price) {
    $variant = new WC_Product_Variation();
    $variant->set_parent_id($product->get_id());
    $variant->set_status('publish');
    $variant->set_attributes(['finish' => $color]);
    $variant->set_sku('UCP-FIX-' . strtoupper($color));
    $variant->set_regular_price($price);
    $variant->set_stock_status('instock');
    $ids[$color] = (string) $variant->save();
}
WC_Product_Variable::sync($product->get_id());
flush_rewrite_rules(false);

file_put_contents('/wordpress/ucp-fixture.json', wp_json_encode([
    'wordpress' => get_bloginfo('version'),
    'woocommerce' => WC_VERSION,
    'php' => PHP_VERSION,
    'product_id' => (string) $product->get_id(),
    'blue_id' => $ids['Blue'],
    'green_id' => $ids['Green'],
]));
